evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics within two hours are unavailable.
Per-trade, strategy-versioned and chain-local retained net P&L after trading fees, slippage, price impact, gas/network fees, priority/MEV fees, platform profit share and fee-settlement cost.
Time-ordered capital exposure and a common valuation currency at contemporaneous prices for cross-chain money-weighted aggregation; native ETH, MATIC, BNB and SOL amounts must not be summed directly.

Solana contemporaneous entry and round-trip sell quotes, receipt-derived priority fees, platform fees, price impact, latency, refundable rent paid/reclaimed and pending rent recovery.
Mutually exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure labels with failure stage and reason.

Promotion requires fresh evidence demonstrating positive retained net P&L over the stated minimum observations, complete cost reconciliation, acceptable execution-failure rates, controlled drawdown and unchanged wallet/signing, simulation, liquidity, sellability, reserve, stop-loss, circuit-breaker, nonce and reconciliation protections.

proposals.downside_risk: Historical windows may not contain complete fee-settlement gas or pending-fee outcomes; such rows must remain unverified rather than be assigned zero cost.

evidence.detail: Direct-market windows consume realised_net_base without subtracting profit_fee_base or separately accounting for fee-settlement execution cost.
EVM leader-copy windows read realised_net_native even though positions also persist the lower realised_user_net_native after profit share.
Execution rows store realised_net_base and profit_fee_base separately; the realised field is calculated before the platform profit share.

proposals.expected_effect: Money-weighted scorecards reflect retained economic value and avoid optimistic promotion or insufficient throttling.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 reconciled closed cycles per strategy and chain, spanning 30 days and multiple congestion/volatility regimes, with at least 95% cost-field completeness; otherwise remain SHADOW.
proposals.rationale: The objective is durable user-retained net P&L after every economic cost. Promotion and throttling decisions based on pre-profit-share P&L can misclassify marginal strategies as profitable.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay closed EVM and Solana observations into a SHADOW-only ledger using reconciled wallet deltas, trading gas/network fees, priority or MEV fees, price impact, slippage, platform fees, fee-settlement gas and refundable-rent treatment. Fail the test if any promoted metric uses a pending cost, mixes native units across chains, or exceeds independently reconciled retained P&L.

proposals.downside_risk: Simulating too many routes increases RPC bandwidth, latency and quote staleness; a bounded top-K and material-change cache are needed.

evidence.detail: Scanner candidates are ordered by expected gross profit minus slippage reserve, excluding estimated gas and user profit-share economics.
The candidate loop breaks on the first route whose wallet-specific simulation passes, so it does not compare retained net edge among passing routes.
The code already calculates a user-retained profit floor, but that information is not used to rank all viable candidates.

proposals.expected_effect: Higher expected retained net P&L per unit of capital and fewer marginal executions, without forcing additional trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 paired decision sets across each enabled EVM chain and 30 days, including congested gas periods, with realised or expiry-marked counterfactual outcomes.
proposals.rationale: Selecting the first valid trade can leave higher executable net edge unused. Ranking must remain chain-local and use wallet-specific retained net value, not raw win probability or gross profit.
proposals.shadow_test: For each EVM decision, simulate only a bounded top-K fresh candidates and compare the existing first-pass choice with the candidate maximizing conservative retained net after gas, slippage, price impact, platform fee, settlement reserve and a measured failure/latency haircut. Stop if extra simulations increase stale-quote or RPC-failure incidence by more than 2 percentage points, or if the challenger has non-positive out-of-sample net uplift.

proposals.downside_risk: Additional quotes consume RPC/API bandwidth and can become stale; SHADOW sampling must be bounded, cached and change-triggered.

evidence.detail: Solana observations intentionally set gross edge, fees, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark outcome_available false because no contemporaneous executable future-return quote is present.
The execution architecture records network fees, priority tips, platform equivalents, rent paid/reclaimed and receipt-derived economics that can support a chain-specific SHADOW outcome layer.
Refundable rent is explicitly separated from economic trading cost and reconciled on closure.

proposals.expected_effect: Determines whether leader-copy signals retain positive follower edge under Solana-specific execution economics while preserving abstention when evidence is incomplete.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 300 independent eligible signals over 30 days, at least 100 completed counterfactual round trips, multiple congestion regimes, and no unresolved cost or sellability fields in any promotion sample.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader profitability is not the follower's executable edge. Solana promotion evidence requires contemporaneous Jupiter round-trip quotes and later receipt-reconciled outcomes including priority fees, impact, latency and rent treatment.
proposals.shadow_test: At signal time, record a non-signing entry quote plus immediately sellable round-trip quote, price impact, slippage, network/priority/platform fees, latency and rent exposure. Mark the hypothetical position at the strategy's actual exit rule and compare with receipt-reconciled outcomes where available. Stop if sellability is missing, quote age breaches the configured bound, total predicted net is non-positive, or quote collection materially degrades the live worker.

proposals.downside_risk: Heuristic classification can understate strategy losses. Unknown or mixed cases must remain UNKNOWN and count conservatively against promotion.

evidence.detail: Windows contain monetary losses and one aggregate execution_failures count but no mutually exclusive STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE classification.
The interface distinguishes a realised result from a boolean execution failure, but it does not preserve failure stage, chain-specific cost or causal category.
Receipt timeout, reverted transaction and other exceptions are all emitted as REJECTED text, limiting reliable causal aggregation.

proposals.expected_effect: Cleaner strategy evaluation, measurable execution drag and targeted remediation without weakening risk controls.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 classified eligible opportunities per chain with 95% non-UNKNOWN coverage and independently checked receipt/reconciliation evidence.
proposals.rationale: A valid signal that loses after an adverse market move is a STRATEGY/MARKET loss. RPC failure, stale quote, simulation failure, revert, receipt timeout, reconciliation gap or worker outage is an EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Combining them causes incorrect strategy replacement and hides operational leakage.
proposals.shadow_test: Classify every eligible opportunity into mutually exclusive MARKET_LOSS, MARKET_WIN, EXECUTION_FAILURE, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, SAFE_ABSTENTION or UNKNOWN using predeclared evidence fields. Audit a stratified sample manually and stop if disagreement exceeds 5% or any failed execution is recorded as a zero-cost strategy skip.

proposals.downside_risk: Extended observation may produce no eligible trades; inactivity is acceptable and must not trigger relaxed safeguards.

evidence.detail: Eligibility thresholds are architecture constants and are not supported here by fresh out-of-sample realised evidence.
Recorded outcomes are quote/simulation economics explicitly marked as non-promotion evidence.

rejected_ideas.reason: The repository correctly marks these SHADOW until an atomic executor exists; sequential legs introduce unacceptable inventory and reversion risk.

rejected_ideas.idea: Auto-add new assets or relax Solana sellability, rent, price-impact or liquidity gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: There is no executable evidence supporting expansion, and these controls protect against unrecoverable positions and cost leakage.

rejected_ideas.reason: That confounds EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE reliability with STRATEGY/MARKET economics and prevents causal improvement.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally requires positive executable edge and preserves simulation, liquidity, sellability and chain-specific execution protections, but current Strategy Lab accounting can overstate user-retained net P&L by recording pre-profit-share results. EVM candidate selection also stops at the first passing simulation rather than selecting the best retained net edge. Solana has detailed fee, priority-fee and refundable-rent controls, but its common SHADOW adapter deliberately lacks executable outcome evidence. Monetary STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be evaluated separately from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures; the current aggregate failure counter is insufficient for that attribution. Runtime forensics are unavailable, so no strategy is shown profitable, canary-ready or live-ready.
